name: waterfall-chart
title: Waterfall Chart
description: Connected balance bridge with signed changes, absolute totals, keyboard exploration, and an accessible data table.

props.name: data
props.description: Ordered label, value, and kind (change or total). Changes accumulate; totals reset the balance. Nonfinite changes leave the balance unchanged.

props.name: config
props.description: increase, decrease, and total semantic colors and labels

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Axis, details, and data table formatter

props.name: onBarClick
props.description: Pointer or keyboard activation with original data index

props.name: reaction
props.description: Per-chart emotion, metric, asset, and resolver overrides

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Message when no finite records remain

ai.purpose: Explain how signed contributions move an opening balance to a closing balance.
compositions: WaterfallChart next to a revenue TrendCard
